verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the Locations API, which says sellers can customize location receipts with a `custom_receipt_text` field that is printed on receipts. That implies Square issues receipts, including printed ones, but it is a single thin mention of customization rather than documentation of the receipt-issuing capability itself. Missing for 10: documentation of email/SMS digital receipt delivery, evidence that receipts meet card-network content requirements, details of the printed-receipt workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
